entry.title: PotentialBleed 1.0.0
entry.summary: ## PotentialBleed 1.0.0 The first release: **ghost bleed for your chops**. It hears each hit and adds quiet synthetic residue behind it, so a loop sounds like it came off a real recording. - **Eight sources:** WIRES, CABINET, SOUNDBOARD, TINES, STRINGS, CYMBAL, ROOM and BARS, all generated (no recordings) - **BLEED**, **SENSE** and **CHANCE** set how much leaks in, how hard a hit has to be, and how often it happens. - **DECAY**, **DUCK**, **GAPS**, **TONE**, **TICK** (a needle tick on each hit)
